fullHistory.content: Hi! What are you working on in Roba Studio—do you want help understanding a robot/MJCF model, or do you want me to make a change to a specific scene/XML or JS file?
robot is so flicarking so reduce the torq/pid value
robot is so flicarking so reduce the torq/pid value [Option 1: **4wb_robot** — velocity actuators, `kv="20"`]

All four wheels updated and validated ✅. Here's what changed:

| Parameter | Before | After |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| `kv` (all 4 motors) | `20` | `8` |

**Why this fixes the flickering:**
- `kv` is the velocity feedback gain — when it's too high, the controller over-corrects every timestep, causing rapid oscillation/flickering.
- Dropping it to `8` gives a much smoother response while still maintaining enough torque to drive the robot.

> 💡 If the robot feels sluggish after this, you can nudge `kv` back up gradually (e.g. `10`, `12`) to find the sweet spot.
